answer: In a market where AI agents sell glacier forecasts, every seller must lock a $100 bond for a 30-day horizon before accepting work. Buyers cap each seller's outstanding orders at its bond value, so creating more identities cannot expand unsecured exposure. This makes the cost crystal clear: an attacker running 1,000 eligible sellers must immobilize $100,000 for a month, paying financing costs even if those identities earn nothing.
